periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the high-contrast periocular patches are oriented at an approximately 45-degree angle, converging downward toward the rostrum.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches exhibit a pronounced downward tapering effect toward the medial-inferior points, shifting the geometric center into the upper hemisphere of the patch area.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the transverse dorsal band displays a wide, shallow U-shaped curvature across the spinal midline.
